title: sedum ochroleucum var. montanum
intro: Sedum ochroleucum var. montanum, commonly known as Gold Leaf Mountain Sedum, is a type of succulent plant that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can help to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Sedum ochroleucum var. montanum include sedation, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help to promote relaxation, relieve muscle spasms, and ease respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
